prompt_digest: Design a highly modular, production-ready Python component that loads a pretrained ResNet50 (without classification head), processes a batch of grayscale or RGB chest X-ray images, and outputs compact 2048-dimensional embeddings ready to feed into an LSTM-based decoder.  The code should handle preprocessing, feature extraction, and dimension projection if required. While ensuring device compatibility (CPU/GPU), batching, and extensibility for other CNN backbones.
